settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subheading: Everything you need to know about ordering, shipping, and our products.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1-2 business days and arrive within 3-7 business days depending on your location. You'll receive a tracking number by email as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: We currently ship within the United States and Canada. We're working on expanding — sign up for our newsletter to be the first to know.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Because our products are food items, we can't accept returns, but if anything arrives damaged or isn't right, contact us within 14 days and we'll make it right.

settings.question: Are your products gluten-free?
settings.answer: Many of our products are gluten-free — look for the label on each product page. Ingredients and allergen information are always listed under the "Ingredients" tab.

settings.question: Do you offer wholesale or bulk pricing?
settings.answer: Yes! Reach out through our contact form and select "Wholesale inquiry" — our team will follow up with pricing tiers and minimum order quantities.

settings.question: How should I store my order after it arrives?
settings.answer: Storage instructions vary by product and are listed on each product page. Most sauces and condiments should be refrigerated after opening.
